scope: Released X-VLA-Pt domain3 plus V1/V2/V3/V4 final M6; original 20 feeding and 20 loading cases each; paired native and single-proposal harness.
setup_checks: 29 focused service tests; 14 rendering/classifier checks across feeding/loading, directed orientations, rotated goals and outside-target cases.
budget_note: Harness is cut off after 180 wall seconds, including inference and evidence logging, after model/scene setup. Native retains the original 1500-step control budget. This is an end-to-end package comparison with unequal compute budgets.
timeout_note: A model call interrupted by the whole-episode deadline is retained in raw runtime_errors. Distinguish that expected cutoff from an integration exception.
outputs: plan.json, per-episode metrics/action and evaluator trajectories/RGB videos, incremental episode-metrics.csv, comparison.csv, progress.json, final validation.json
